exposure: Grand multiparous women with one previous Caesarean section (CS)
Induction of labor with prostaglandin E(2) (PGE(2)) gel
Grand multiparous women without previous CS
cohort: 200 grand multiparous (GMP) women; 96 with one previous CS and 104 without previous CS
finding: Induction of labor with 1 mg of PGE(2) gel in grand multiparous women with one previous CS is appropriate and appears to be safe for both mother and baby.
mod_finding: Induction of labor with a low dose of prostaglandin E(2) gel appears safe for both mother and baby in grand multiparous women with one previous cesarean section.
